video: What happens when you send a message to ChatGPT
note: Restructured from eight cut scenes into one continuous 30s shot. Status is the only field a steady-state session flips. Never reword or delete acceptance criteria to make something pass - that is a correctness bug, not a shortcut.

features.title: The set: every location laid out once in world space
acceptance: Chat, web server, four stations inside one model box, and a return rail form a closed loop
Total extent is under ~50 units, so the final pull-back stays legible
Every anchor the choreography needs (entry, exit, slot, rail endpoints) is addressable without recomputing geometry
full_loop() yields a single path a payload can traverse in one animation

features.title: 0-6s: type, send, and cross the wire
acceptance: The question is typed character by character, not faded in whole
Sent text becomes a right-aligned user bubble and the composer empties
The message becomes a physical packet that then travels a visible rail
The web server reacts on arrival
Camera and packet move together - the shot never stops to wait

features.title: 6-21s: four close-ups inside the model
acceptance: Tokenize, embed, transformer and sample each get a close-up in pipeline order
The payload is visibly transformed at each station, never destroyed and replaced
Nothing is clipped: every bay and its caption fit the tight shot
The elided middle of the 96-layer stack is obvious, not hidden
Neighbouring bays stay partly in frame so the viewer keeps their bearings

features.title: 21-25s: the token rides home and becomes a word
acceptance: The token travels the return rail as one continuous move, not a series of hops
The reply bubble is sized for the finished sentence up front and never reflows
The first words land before the camera leaves the chat

features.title: 25-30s: the whole plant, running
acceptance: Every part of the pipeline is in frame at once
Station marquees are readable and do not overlap each other or the box title
At least three more tokens complete the full circuit
The reply finishes filling in as they land

features.title: Lock timing against a recorded voice-over
acceptance: Narration in script.md is recorded and its per-beat timings measured
run_time values are adjusted so beats land on the narration, not the other way round
Total runtime stays within 10% of 30s

features.title: Show attention explicitly inside the transformer close-up
features.note: lib.components.transformer.AttentionLines and AttentionMatrix already exist and are tested; the current close-up only sweeps the stack. Worth adding only if the 4s beat can carry it without feeling rushed.
acceptance: Weighted links from one token to earlier tokens are visible
The causal mask reads - no token attends to its future
The beat still fits its slice of the 30s budget
